title: quant: improve INT8/FP8 kernels with smoothquant and dequant fusion
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: production workloads show significant token cost and latency sensitivity when serving quantized models. This PR implements several kernel-level optimizations for INT8/FP8 inference: 1) fuse dequantization into the matmul kernel to avoid an extra memory pass and reduce tensor memory traffic; 2) add a fused SmoothQuant calibration path so weight scaling is applied inside the quantized GEMM kernel for reduced error and faster warmup; 3) optimize the FP8 fast path and codegen to better utilize tensor cores on A100/H100 and fall back efficiently on older hardware; 4) scheduler hint adjustments to preserve low-latency for small interactive batches while allowing high-throughput batched workloads to amortize dequantization overhead. Motivation: reduce per-token cost and P99 latency regressions observed when enabling quantized weights in production, particularly for long-context generation with KV cache churn. Checklist: - [x] Implement fused dequant+GEMM CUDA kernels (cpp/cuda) - [x] Integrate SmoothQuant scaling into quant kernels and add calibration hook - [x] Add CPU fallback optimized code paths (AVX512/AMX friendly) - [x] Add microbench harness and perf regression tests - [x] Add unit tests for numeric parity and dynamic range checks - [x] Update model-registry quant profiles and release notes Changes: description includes high-level commit summary and lists of modified modules. See commits for details. Benchmark summary included below.

perf_summary: Microbench (A100, FP16 baseline vs INT8/FP8 fused): throughput +1.28x for 2048-token seq/bs=8, P99 latency -15% for interactive bs=1 with 8k KV cache; end-to-end token cost reduction ~18% on sampled production traces. Numeric parity: max per-token logit delta < 1e-3 compared to reference FP16 baseline after SmoothQuant calibration.
notes: Hotfix path: CPU fallback retained. Back-compat: if fused kernels are not available or feature_flag is false, runtime uses existing dequant -> gemm flow. Ops teams notified to schedule staged rollout and monitor 'quant.smoothquant.scale_offset'.
changelog_entry: Add fused dequant+GEMM kernels and SmoothQuant-in-kernel support for INT8/FP8 quantized inference; performance and quality improvements for quantized models.
smoketest_instructions: Enable feature flag enable_fused_quant_kernels on a test worker, run benchmarks/bench_fused_kernels.py and ensure perf-gate passes, run integration smoke with llm-echo scenario and validate no regression in outputs.
